name: Hetzner Object Storage
tax_note: Product page FAQ: 'All prices are exclusive of VAT'; docs: additional storage is billed as '(net price * TB-hours) + VAT'.

regions.note: Product page FAQ: 'Falkenstein, DE (FSN1)'. The location code is also the region name used in the docs' tool examples (region = fsn1).

storage_classes.name: Object Storage

capacity_gb.note: FAQ: 'This base price includes 1 TB of storage (up to 744 TB-hours) and 1 TB of egress traffic.' Not a hard cap: usage above the included quota is billed per TB-hour (see notes). TB is decimal: docs bill excess 'in increments of 100 MB ( = 0.0001 TB)'.

monthly_price.note: Base price per account, product CLOUD_84, datacenter ALL, monthly EUR 6.49 (hourly EUR 0.0104, capped at the monthly price). This is the official price API the product page uses to fill its FAQ text 'We charge a base price of ... per month'; billed for every hour with at least one bucket, even if empty.

put_per_1000.note: FAQ 'What traffic is free of charge?': 'S3 API calls such as PUT, GET, or DELETE requests.' Docs overview confirms S3 operations are free (egress caused by them is billed).

get_per_1000.note: FAQ: S3 API calls such as PUT, GET, or DELETE are free of charge.

list_per_1000.note: Docs 'Pricing': 'S3 operations such as PUT, GET, or DELETE' are free of charge; LIST is not named explicitly but falls under S3 operations.

price_per_gb.note: No retrieval fee line for this single hot class; only egress traffic is billed. Absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

typical_delay.note: Not applicable (hot storage); no delay stated.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: No minimum storage duration is stated on the product page or docs overview checked; storage is billed per TB-hour.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Docs 'Minimum billable object size': 'Minimum: 64 kB'; smaller objects are charged as if they had this size (also in the product page FAQ).

notes: Modelled as a fixed plan because a base price is mandatory: EUR 6.49/month per account includes 1 TB storage and 1 TB egress (quota accrues per hour of use; unused quota expires at month end).

Storage above the included quota: EUR 0.0087 per TB-hour (price API product CLOUD_85, read 2026-10-13, https://website-price-api.hetzner.com/api/v1/products/CLOUD_85). Hetzner states only the hourly price, so no per GB-month value is recorded.
Docs table of maximum included storage: 744 TB-hours in a 31-day month, 720 in 30 days, 696 in 29 days, 672 in 28 days.
One price for all locations: the price API lists datacenter 'ALL'.

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: FAQ: base price includes '1 TB of egress traffic'. The docs table gives a per-hour accruing traffic quota of max. 1.0080 TB (28-day month) to max. 1.1160 TB (31-day month); the product page figure is used here.

egress.free_allowance_scope: Per account, across all buckets, projects and locations; included with the base price and accrued per hour of use; expires at month end.

price.note: Price API product CLOUD_86 (datacenter ALL): EUR 1.00, shown on the product page as 'Egress traffic: ... per TB'. Normalised to per GB with decimal TB (docs: 100 MB = 0.0001 TB).

notes: Free of charge (product page and docs): ingress traffic and internal traffic within the eu-central network zone.
Excess storage and traffic are billed in increments of 100 MB (0.0001 TB).

egress_fair_use.note: No fair-use rule for egress was found on the product page or docs overview; egress above the included quota is billed per TB.

free_tier.note: No free tier is mentioned on the product page or docs overview; the base price is charged for every hour with at least one bucket.

object_lock.note: Docs how-to 'Object Lock: Retention' (also Legal Hold); product page lists 'Object locking: Lock objects against deletion or overwriting'.

s3_endpoints.label: Falkenstein
s3_endpoints.note: Docs 'Available endpoints'. Docs document virtual-hosted URLs (https://<bucket-name>.<location>.your-objectstorage.com) and the s3cmd guide sets the DNS-style template %(bucket)s.fsn1.your-objectstorage.com.

s3_endpoints.label: Nuremberg
s3_endpoints.note: Docs 'Available endpoints'; virtual-hosted style as documented.

s3_endpoints.label: Helsinki
s3_endpoints.note: Docs 'Available endpoints'; virtual-hosted style as documented.

notes: Separate product from Hetzner Storage Box.
Limits (docs): up to 100 buckets, 100 TB and 50,000,000 objects per bucket, 5 TB per object.
